title: Holy Sect Elder
next_chapter_hook: The Holy Sect Elder transformed into a streak of black light and fled through the void. The distress signal sent before his death, however, had already spread across a hundred li. In the next instant, dozens of Nascent Soul auras were rapidly closing in from all directions.

text.content: The moment the formation patterns on the prison cell walls illuminated, Chen Ji's footsteps remained steady, his lips even curving slightly upward. That was the smile of one who had anticipated everything—from the moment he stepped into this prison cell, he had never intended to leave quietly. "The trash of the Tianqing Sect actually has some courage." An aged and arrogant voice drifted from the depths of the cell. Frigid spiritual energy pressed down like substance, and an elderly man draped in black robes slowly emerged from the shadows. The demonic energy coiling around him was suffocating. Chen Ji raised his gaze, a cold glint flickering in his eyes—Nascent Soul Early Stage, Holy Sect Outer Disciple Elder, Li Qingfeng.

dialogue.content: "Trash?" Chen Ji softly repeated these two words, his tone calm to the point of gentleness. "Elder Li's information is quite up-to-date, even knowing the affairs of a servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect." He paused, tilting his head. "I only wonder, what brings Elder personally to this place?"

Li Qingfeng sneered, pointing forward with his withered finger. Demonic energy slithered toward Chen Ji like venomous serpents: "For the item on your person. The Holy Sect has searched for it for three hundred years, and today we finally have a lead." His gaze was like looking at a corpse. "Hand it over obediently, and this old man can give you a quick death. Otherwise..." He licked his lips. "The Holy Sect has plenty of ways to make you spill the secrets of the Tianji Record."

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing. The air in the cell seemed to freeze, Li Qingfeng's pressure bearing down like a collapsing mountain. Yet just then, a cold laugh drifted from the shadows on the other side of the cell: "Elder Li, what great authority you display, coming to seize someone in the Holy Sect's territory without even giving advance notice." The black mist dissipated, revealing a graceful figure—Ye Qing's face carried frost, yet she walked out slowly with a hint of playful amusement. Her appearance caused Li Qingfeng's expression to change slightly.

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing?" A flash of wariness crossed Li Qingfeng's eyes, then he sneered. "The Holy Saintess's airs are becoming more pronounced. But I must ask, why protect a piece of trash from the Tianqing Sect?" Ye Qing laughed lightly: "Trash?" She glanced at Chen Ji, a hint of deeper meaning flickering in her eyes that wasn't easily察觉. "Some things cannot be judged by appearances. If Elder Li is wise, it's still not too late to leave now."

Chen Ji suddenly laughed lightly, interrupting this tense confrontation. He unhurriedly straightened his sleeves, his tone unworried: "Miss Ye doesn't need to worry on my account." He raised his head,直视 Li Qingfeng's murky yet sinister eyes. "This Elder Li has traveled a thousand li to find me, surely with full confidence. However—" His tone suddenly shifted, becoming ice-cold and piercing. "He seems to have forgotten one thing."

"Three years ago, Elder Li's prized disciple Li Yun died at the hands of a trash in Luoxia Valley." Chen Ji spoke word by word, each word like a nail driven into the air. "I wonder if Elder still remembers this?" Li Qingfeng's face changed drastically, his demonic energy surging violently: "You—!" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Your memory seems good. That puts me at ease. Today, this debt should be settled."

choice.prompt: Li Qingfeng, hit where it hurt most, attacked in rage! Faced with a full-power strike from a Nascent Soul cultivator, Chen Ji had to make a choice—

choices.text: Stand firm and clash head-on, breaking force with force
choices.description: Directly reveal his true strength at Golden Core Early Stage, crushing Nascent Soul arrogance with absolute cultivation gap
choices.visible_reward: Slap him publicly on the spot, shocking all present
choices.risk_hint: Revealing strength may draw greater trouble

text.content: Li Qingfeng laughed coldly in extreme rage, his palms forming seals rapidly. A pitch-black demonic technique erupted forth with a palm strike: "A mere Golden Core Early Stage, daring to act so insolently before this old man!" The Nascent Soul pressure swept through like a tsunami, the formation shield in the cell trembling violently. Ye Qing's expression changed slightly,正要 intervening, yet she saw Chen Ji raise a hand to stop him—he didn't even step back. Golden Core spiritual pressure rose slowly from within his body, then suddenly surged violently!

choices.text: Feign weakness while secretly preparing, lure him into underestimation
choices.description: First show weakness to make Li Qingfeng careless, then reveal hidden trump cards at the critical moment for maximum humiliation
choices.risk_hint: Slight misstep may result in injury

text.content: A sharp gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, but his figure suddenly retreated several steps, putting on an act of being suppressed by the pressure. Li Qingfeng saw this and grinned wickedly: "What, scared? Trash is always trash!" He pressed forward step by step, demonic technique condensing in his palm. "Kneel before this old man!" Chen Ji lowered his head, shoulders trembling slightly—actually, the corner of his mouth had already curved into a cold smile. Nascent Soul Early Stage? Nothing more. He was waiting precisely for this arrogance.

Li Qingfeng's palm wind howled forth, carrying violent force enough to crush a Golden Core cultivator to pulp. Yet at this critical moment, Chen Ji suddenly raised his head—that pair of eyes held no fear, no panic, only an abyss of cold. His right hand slowly rose, index and middle fingers pressed together, pointing forward lightly. "Tianxuan Breaking Void Point." Chen Ji murmured softly, his voice calm as water. First form, Breaking Army.

dialogue.content: A blade qi of piercing sharpness shot forth from Chen Ji's fingertips. That sword light was dazzling to the extreme, as if it would cleave this dark prison cell in two. With a thunderous roar, Li Qingfeng's demonic technique was torn apart! His figure stumbled backward, eyes wide, face filled with disbelief: "What—what technique is this?! You, a Golden Core Early Stage—" Chen Ji stepped forward, his gaze ice-cold: "Golden Core Early Stage? Elder Li, when you called me trash just now, did you ever imagine this day would come?"

text.content: Chen Ji's second finger had already extended. This point was even more fierce, even more violent. As sword qi crisscrossed, the formation shield throughout the entire cell shattered with a boom! Li Qingfeng screamed, his left arm pierced by sword qi, blood spurting wildly. He stumbled backward, the arrogance on his face long replaced by fear: "Impossible! A mere Golden Core cultivator, how could he possess such combat power!" Chen Ji sheathed his fingers and stood with hands behind his back, his robes rustling in the wind, his expression so indifferent it seemed he had merely done a trivial matter.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing watched, dazzled and enchanted. Though she knew Chen Ji was hiding his true depth, she never imagined his strength could reach such heights. That single finger just now even made her, a Nascent Soul demonic path Saintess, feel a chill in her heart. "Elder Li." Ye Qing coldly smiled, striking at the opportune moment. Ghostly flames of the netherworld transformed into chains binding Li Qingfeng's legs. "If you want to leave now, it's too late." Li Qingfeng's face turned deathly pale, torn between options. Chen Ji's sword qi followed closely behind, sealing all his escape routes.

choice.prompt: Li Qingfeng was now a cornered beast. How to deal with this Holy Sect Elder?

choices.text: Eliminate the roots, leave no future troubles
choices.description: Directly kill Li Qingfeng, permanently ending the threat, but this will completely infuriate the Holy Sect
choices.visible_cost: Completely become enemies with the Holy Sect
choices.risk_hint: May provoke frenzied revenge from the Holy Sect

text.content: Kill intent blazed in Chen Ji's eyes as his right hand rose once more. Tianxuan Breaking Void Point Third Form—Kaiyang! This finger condensed all his combat intent. The sword light transformed into a rainbow, directly targeting Li Qingfeng's brow center. Li Qingfeng's pupils contracted sharply, his voice shrieking: "You dare! This old man is a Holy Sect Elder—kill me—" Before he finished speaking, the sword light had arrived. Blood splattered, and a generation of Nascent Soul Elder fell.

choices.description: Deliberately let Li Qingfeng escape, allowing him to spread terror within the Holy Sect, expanding Chen Ji's deterrence
choices.visible_reward: Fame spreads far, making the Holy Sect tremble
choices.risk_hint: Li Qingfeng may bring greater troubles

text.content: Chen Ji's finger halted in mid-air,迟迟 not executing the final strike. Li Qingfeng trembled all over,正要 begging for mercy when he saw Chen Ji smile faintly: "Killing you would be too easy." His voice was soft, yet it made Li Qingfeng feel as if falling into an icy abyss. "Go back and tell the people of the Holy Sect—the Tianji Record is with me, Chen Ji. Anyone who dares come claim it, I await them anytime." As his voice fell, a blinding light erupted in the cell—Chen Ji had released the binding seal on Li Qingfeng's body.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing watched Li Qingfeng's狼狈 fleeing figure,忍不住轻笑出声: "Chen Gongzi such clever means. Releasing the tiger to the mountains—making the roots and shoots wither causes greater fear than simply eliminating them." Chen Ji withdrew his fingers, his expression unworried: "Miss Ye过奖. A Nascent Soul Early Stage elder, whether dead or alive holds no great significance to the Holy Sect. Letting him live and return would反而 make the Holy Sect hesitate." He paused. "As for Miss Ye's timely assistance just now, Chen Mou owes you a favor."

Ye Qing's eyes flickered, watching Chen Ji with a knowing smile: "Chen Gongzi's strength exceeds my imagination by far." She suddenly lowered her voice. "Tianxuan Breaking Void Point... this is an ancient sword cultivator secret technique. Where did Gongzi learn it?" Chen Ji did not answer directly, merely giving her a meaningful look: "Since Miss Ye knows the origin of this technique, surely you understand—some matters should not be asked." The two exchanged glances for a moment, then Ye Qing suddenly laughed: "Interesting. Chen Gongzi is indeed a fascinating person."

text.content: Suddenly, violent spiritual energy fluctuations came from outside the cell. Li Qingfeng's distress signal had been sent, and at least three Nascent Soul auras were approaching from the distance! Ye Qing's expression changed slightly: "Holy Sect reinforcements are coming—at least three Nascent Soul cultivators." Yet Chen Ji's expression remained normal, as if早有预料: "Miss Ye, would you be willing to cooperate with me once more?" He raised his hand, an ancient jade talisman appearing in his palm. "I have a way for us to escape unscathed—but I need Gongzi's demonic path mist for cover."

choice.prompt: Holy Sect reinforcements are arriving. How to handle this critical situation?

choices.text: Use the demonic mist to immediately retreat
choices.description: Use Ye Qing's demonic path mist to cover the retreat, preserve strength, avoid being surrounded

text.content: Ye Qing agreed without hesitation. Her demonic energy surged, and dark mist rapidly enveloped the entire cell. At the same time, the jade talisman in Chen Ji's palm glowed, an intricate formation pattern manifesting beneath both their feet. "Go!" Chen Ji low喝一声, the talisman activated, and both figures vanished on the spot. When the three Nascent Soul cultivators arrived, they only saw an empty cell and utter chaos—along with Li Qingfeng's severed arm and bloodstains left behind.

choices.text: Set an ambush, wait for the enemy at ease
choices.description: While Holy Sect reinforcements are still unstable, set traps and ambush them, catching the enemy off guard
choices.risk_hint: May fall into a bitter battle

text.content: A sharp gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as another formation flag appeared in his hand: "Miss Ye, help me hold them for three breaths of time." Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: "How much confidence do you have?" Chen Ji smiled lightly: "Enough." Three breaths later, the moment the three Nascent Soul cultivators charged into the cell, countless formation patterns blazed brilliantly—Death Trap Formation! Chen Ji had actually prepared this backup long ago. The three Nascent Soul cultivators fell into the formation, immediately trapped in a bitter battle. Meanwhile, Chen Ji and Ye Qing had vanished into the mist.

dialogue.content: Dozens of li away, in a secluded mountain valley. Chen Ji and Ye Qing's figures tumbled out of the void. The latter's face was slightly pale,显然 the consecutive casting had drained her considerably. Chen Ji took an elixir from his sleeve and handed it over: "Miss Ye has worked hard." Ye Qing accepted the elixir but did not immediately take it, instead staring at Chen Ji with burning intensity: "Chen Gongzi, just who are you? The Tianji Record... the legacy of the ancient prophetic seers—how much do you actually know?"

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer directly. He gazed toward the direction of the Holy Sect in the distance, his eyes deep as an abyss: "Miss Ye, the more one knows about certain things, the faster one dies." He turned to look at Ye Qing, his tone suddenly serious. "Since we are cooperating, I will be frank. The Holy Sect seeks the Tianji Record, not merely for this treasure—they are searching for something that can oppose the Heavenly Dao." Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply. Chen Ji continued: "The seal the Holy Sect placed on Gongzi's body—I can remove it for you. But the condition is—cooperate with me until we uncover the Holy Sect's greatest secret."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing fell silent for a long while. The mountain wind stirred her hair, her face half illuminated and half shadowed by moonlight. Finally, she spoke: "Chen Gongzi's conditions—I need time to consider." She paused. "However, today's matter—I owe Gongzi a favor. The Holy Sect won't let this rest. What are you planning to do next?" Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, gazing at the faint glow on the horizon: "Next step... it's time to let the Three Great Sects know that the Tianji Record is in my hands." His tone was calm, yet revealed a terrifying霸道的 confidence.

text.content: Ye Qing was visibly shaken upon hearing this: "You intend to provoke the Three Great Sects actively?" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Not provocation—a grand gift." His eyes flickered with calculating brilliance. "The Three Great Sects and the Holy Sect are in uneasy alliance, each harboring secret designs. If we let them know the Holy Sect is seeking the Tianji Record... what do you think, will they sit by and do nothing?" Ye Qing inhaled a sharp breath, then giggled: "Chen Gongzi, your mind... truly frightening." Chen Ji said calmly: "Too kind." He turned and walked toward the depths of the valley, his silhouette stretching long in the dawn light. "Until we meet again, Miss Ye."

When Ye Qing's demonic path mist finally dissipated, Li Qingfeng finally escaped that damned prison cell. His left arm was completely ruined, his spiritual energy flowing out like a broken dam, but the distress signal had been sent—three Nascent Soul fellow disciples were on their way. Yet when he saw the empty prison cell behind him, a terror more terrible than death welled up in his heart. That Golden Core trash actually dared to let him go? No, this was not mercy—this was—Li Qingfeng suddenly realized something, his face turning deathly pale.

dialogue.content: Just then, three streaks of black light tore across the sky from the horizon. Three Nascent Soul cultivators appeared simultaneously. The leader, seeing Li Qingfeng's miserable state, was immediately livid: "Junior Brother Li! Who did this?" Li Qingfeng's lips trembled, difficultly uttering a few words: "T-Tianqing Sect... that trash... he has..." Before he finished, he suddenly screamed—the sword qi Chen Ji had left in his body had finally erupted, beginning to wildly erode his meridians. The three Nascent Soul cultivators were greatly alarmed,连忙出手 to suppress it, yet the霸道 degree of that sword qi far exceeded their imagination.

text.content: Meanwhile, tens of thousands of li away within the Inner Sect of Tianqing Sect. Su Qingyao suddenly opened her eyes from meditation, her brow tightly furrowed. In that instant, she had sensed an extremely familiar yet foreign aura—a spiritual pressure fluctuation unique to Chen Ji, yet the power intertwined within it was far beyond what any servant disciple could possess. "Chen Ji..." she murmured, a complex light flickering in her gaze. "How many secrets are you still hiding?" Her fingers unconsciously gripped the sword at her waist, an inexplicable unease spreading in her heart.

The Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's spiritual sea glowed softly. Mr. Mo's aged yet distant voice rang out once more: "Volume One, Step Two complete. The matter of Li Qingfeng will be like a butterfly flapping its wings, sweeping through the entire cultivation world." He paused, his voice carrying a hint of profoundmeaningful的 amusement. "But tell me, little friend, are you certain you wish to reveal your strength at this moment? The Eye of Heavenly Dao... has always been watching you." Chen Ji's footsteps paused slightly, a cold glint passing through the depths of his eyes, yet he did not speak. He raised his head, gazing at the seemingly eternal vast heavens—as if something was watching him from the endless void.
